verdict.rationale: Daytona is a cloud sandbox service that hosts user code and data, so a buyer could fairly ask whether that data is excluded from AI model training. The evidence pack has no training opt-out, no data-use policy and no no-training commitment. The network firewall and sandbox isolation docs address code exfiltration and runtime separation, not training use, so they are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
